question:
Study the given bar graph and answer the question that follows.

The following bar graph shows the quarterly profit (in lakhs) of a departmental store from 1997 to 2000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13f6c3ebfe01131f94cb68a14f4a83db5ca3986cc421c279e56ca85e5783f5b5.png] 

What was the percentage increase in annual profit of the departmental store from 1997 to 2000?
solution:

Total profit in 1997 = 135 + 115 + 90 + 70 = 410 lakh

Total profit in 2000 = 150 + 180 + 210 + 230 = 770 lakh

The formula to calculate the percentage increase is:
